Before p15-introduction, add four short review items: (a) For g(t)=t²−2t, write g(x+h) without expanding. Answer: (x+h)²−2(x+h). (b) Expand (x+h)². Answer: x²+2xh+h². (c) Expand and simplify (x+h)²−2(x+h)−(x²−2x). Answer: 2xh+h²−2h. (d) Factorise the numerator and simplify (6h+h²)/h, where h≠0. Answer: h(6+h)/h=6+h. Keep the review within one page.
